# San Diego Union-Tribune

> The San Diego Union-Tribune is Southern California's leading local news source covering breaking news, sports, politics, and community events across San Diego County and the broader region.

As a major regional newspaper, the Union-Tribune provides comprehensive coverage of local government, civic engagement, and community issues while maintaining journalistic standards and editorial integrity. The publication serves as a primary news source for San Diego-area residents and maintains active engagement with its community through advisory boards and newsroom accessibility.
